items.name: American Motorcyclist Association (AMA)
items.notes: Primary US governing body for amateur and professional motorcycle road racing, sanctions AMA Pro Road Racing.

items.name: Canadian Motorcyclist Association (CMA)
items.notes: National governing body for motorcycle sport in Canada; FIM affiliate.

items.name: FCAR — Fédération de cyclomoteurs et d'automobiles du Québec
items.notes: Quebec provincial authority for motorsport including motorcycle road racing.

items.name: Motorcycle Sport Association of Ontario
items.notes: Sanctions club-level road races in Ontario.
